race.description: First Mates Lounge @ Men Matter Hcp (55)
race.comment: AZUKI (5) found the line nicely last start to get up for third over 1220m at Toowoomba. Drawn to stalk the leaders and will get some weight off with the 2kg claim. Sure to give a great sight. The well-related ZAYYANO (2) (half to 2xG1 winner Grunt) proved too strong two runs ago at Kilcoy. Couldn't follow that up last time out when eighth over 1350m at Warwick, beaten 6 lengths after being in the firing line on the bend. Rock-hard fit now and he is up to the task. MOET AT MIDNIGHT (9) strips fitter second-up from the spell and maps ideally for this from gate four. In the mix. PEACH GALANTES (14) was below her best last time when eighth after being prominent at the bend over 1300m at Toowoomba, beaten 6 lengths. Draws the inside marble and deserves another chance.
